notes:
• Test devices: Android phones and emulators on the Mac, shared by agents and people. Settings → Test devices on the Mac installs what's missing (adb, scrcpy) and names each device; iPhone, iPad and Android list them above the projects and show a device live, with touch, typing with the phone's keyboard, take over and notes. Agents drive them with `dh` and the bundled android-devices skill. A note someone leaves at a device, or a device handed back, arrives in the agent's chat, and an agent handing a device over sends a push.
• Mac: tables in a reply are part of its text, so a selection runs across cells, rows and the text around them; copied, cells come out separated by tabs and rows by line breaks, ready to paste into a spreadsheet. Tables with images in them can still only be selected cell by cell. On iPhone, iPad and Android tables stay as they were.
